summary: Find every same-color nonzero 4-connected object and retain objects whose bounding-box area exceeds two. Collect every retained bbox top/bottom+1 and left/right+1 edge to form row and column intervals. For each interval pair, take the first retained object's color whose bbox covers the whole slot. Emit that slot-color matrix with each row's columns reversed.
